title: 排序步骤3 投影
query: π employee_id, last_name, department_id, salary (σ salary > 5400 (employees))

title: 排序步骤4 排序
query: τ department_id asc, salary desc (π employee_id, last_name, department_id, salary (σ salary > 5400 (employees)))

title: 分组步骤2 非空部门
分组步骤3 聚合
query: γ department_id; count(employee_id)→employee_count, avg(salary)→avg_salary (σ department_id != null (employees))

title: 分组步骤4 筛选组
query: σ avg_salary > 4800 (γ department_id; count(employee_id)→employee_count, avg(salary)→avg_salary (σ department_id != null (employees)))

title: 分组步骤5 排序
query: τ avg_salary desc (σ avg_salary > 4800 (γ department_id; count(employee_id)→employee_count, avg(salary)→avg_salary (σ department_id != null (employees))))

title: 连接步骤2 等值连接
连接步骤3 投影
query: π departments.department_id, department_name, employee_id, last_name (employees ⨝ employees.department_id = departments.department_id departments)

title: 连接步骤4 排序后投影
query: π departments.department_id, department_name, employee_id, last_name (τ departments.department_id asc, salary asc (employees ⨝ employees.department_id = departments.department_id departments))
